title: JWT session tokens
author: benchmark
note: Hardcoded JWT signing key with a name the simple regex doesn't cover.

changed_files.diff:
+import jwt
+import datetime
+
+JWT_SIGNING_KEY = "my-very-secret-signing-key-2024"
+
+def issue_token(user_id):
+    payload = {"sub": user_id, "exp": datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(hours=8)}
+    return jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SIGNING_KEY, algorithm="HS256")
